bw.label: BW-style / CLI-adapted

rubric_scores.evidence: The hall has repeated columns, roof beams and strip windows, but the roof is a plain slab without corrugation. Roof tiers and assembly connections are insufficiently legible in the delivered hero.
Foreground conveyors, intermediate upright tank, rear raised machinery and left-side windows preserve the broad zoning. Relative equipment sizes remain broadly plausible.
Four substantial housings sit on a supported raised deck. However, their hero appearance is predominantly flat white-gray, without readable brushed stainless highlights.

Yellow rails and three stairs are modeled, but the tank visibly occupies the central stair route. Platform end protection is incomplete, and the uniform yellow shader lacks the specified surface variation.
The sparse utility system has only one long process-pipe run, no readable reducer, and dangling hanger rods without coherent attachments. Silver surfaces are smooth rather than crinkled foil.

The upright tank has cylindrical and rounded-head geometry plus two feet, but its nozzles are plain cylinders without flanges. The hero shows a uniform pale turquoise finish rather than worn dark-green metal.
Substantial matte-blue conveyor lanes have rollers, guides and legs. The declared drive motor is only an unfeatured six-face box, without an identifiable drive assembly or transmission connection.

The green floor has visible reflections and systems are color-separated, but illumination reads as broad studio fill rather than dominant side-window daylight. Stainless and foil responses are not differentiated.
The elevated, mildly diagonal hero keeps the roof frame, foreground conveyors, tank, raised machines and overhead utilities jointly recognizable with natural perspective.
The editable project opens, uses Cycles and AgX, and has no external textures. However, native render denoising is disabled and the original delivered image exhibits conspicuous noise.
The original delivery is a valid, fully decoded PNG, but measures 512×267 instead of 3840×2160.

dimension_scores.evidence: The principal scene and color zones correspond, but machinery, utilities and foreground equipment are heavily simplified.
Deck and conveyor supports are visible, but the tank obstructs the central stairs and utility hangers terminate without convincing attachments.
Yellow guarding, blue conveyors and green floor are distinct; pale tank and white machine bodies weaken the target palette and industrial character.
Primitive box housings, sparse fittings, faceted ducts and conspicuous render noise make the installation look schematic.
The main foreground-to-platform ordering and side-window relationship survive, though equipment is arranged more uniformly and access clearances are flawed.
Machine, platform and tank sizes broadly agree, but roof members appear slender for the span and conveyor rollers are unusually sparse.
Soft lighting and floor reflections establish volume, but flat metallic surfaces, weak daylight direction and noise reduce material readability.
All major object classes appear, but detailed utility networks, fittings, roof profiling, usable access details and the required image resolution are missing.

bw.same_model_bias_limit: Research and independent judge use Astra; separate sessions do not establish human independence.

structure.structure_requirement: At least 3 nonempty finite meshes, all meshes finite and all object matrices finite
structure.group_interpretation: Structural operability only; no claim of semantic or true 3D recovery

target.rule: lexicographically first non-root EMPTY with >=2 nonstructural finite mesh descendants

approximate_relations.limitation: AABB candidates only, not true mesh contact/collision; no ground truth support labels

hierarchy_parts.meaning: Integrity of emitted part declarations; not completeness against reference image

known_support.meaning: Declared support; normalized AABB contact approximation, not true mesh support

mesh_intersection.meaning: Triangle surface crossings; intended joints may also intersect. No containment test or semantic collision truth; supplemental, not hard gate

structure.measurement_limit: AABB extents are approximate, not collision tests; unknown scale, no metric 3D accuracy

target_selection.rule: lexicographically first non-root EMPTY with >=2 nonstructural finite mesh descendants

non_target_preservation.comparison: Exact direct comparison of matrices, local vertices, material values/nodes and parent; no hashes

material.operation: Copy target mesh/materials, replace target surface with blue Principled shader

move.normalization: nonstructural scene AABB diagonal; no true metric scale

non_target_preservation.comparison: Exact direct comparison of matrices, local vertices, material values/nodes and parent; no hashes

functional.interpretation: Mechanical structure/material operation; no text editor or natural-image 3D ground truth. Support AABB approximate; optional collision crossings not full solidity truth.

evaluation_scope: seconds is current evaluation/generation invocation wall; resumed evaluation is recorded separately; see timing.csv for every process
